name: Tuna Melt Toastie
method: Drain the tuna and mix with the mayonnaise in a bowl. Spread over one slice of bread, top with grated cheddar and the second slice.
Butter the outside of the sandwich and fry in a pan over a medium heat for 3 minutes, then flip and cook for 3 minutes more until golden and the cheese has melted.
Cut in half and serve while hot.
